screens.title: DetailHuawei
screens.prompt:
Screen: DetailHuawei. 
Context: Part of the Beltelecom Field PWA (technician app).
Visuals: Light theme, Manrope font, Primary #663479, Accent #33CEE1, Background #F5F3F7, Cards white with 16-20px radius. 
Layout:
1. Top Bar: Purple (#663479), text "Назад" (leading back icon), title "Beltelecom Portal".
2. Tabs: Under toolbar. Tabs are "Сервисы", "Huawei xPON", "История", "Вторичка". "Huawei xPON" is the ACTIVE tab (purple underline/indicator).
3. Body: 
   - Summary card (collapsed head card) showing address "ул. Макаёнка, 9, кв. 114" and status "0: НЕТ ДАННЫХ".
   - Main Technical Card:
     - Modem status badge: "в сети" (green accent).
     - Port status: "[ON]" (accent color).
     - Profile: "Ясна 200 Смарт".
     - Services Chips: "ByFly", "IPTV", "IMS" (subtle gray background chips).
   - Metric Rows (list of specs with icons):
     - Оптический уровень: −19.8 дБм
     - Лазер TX: Включен
     - Серийный номер: HWTC4A7B2C91
     - Температура: 42°C
4. Bottom Island: Floating nav with "Inbox" and "Closed" icons.

Interactive Links:
- «Назад» (Back) -> {{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_12}} (Inbox)
- Tab «Сервисы» -> {{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_2}} (DetailServices)
- Tab «История» -> DetailHistory (placeholder)
- Tab «Вторичка» -> DetailSecondary (placeholder)
- Island «Inbox» -> {{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_12}}
- Island «Closed» -> {{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_9}}

Language: Russian. No emojis. Professional PWA style.

outputComponents.text:
I've created the **DetailHuawei** screen for your Beltelecom Field PWA prototype.

### Design Key Features:
*   **Technical xPON Data**: Dedicated section for optical levels (-19.8 dBm), laser status, serial numbers, and equipment temperature, following the technician-focused requirements.
*   **Brand Consistency**: Applied the Beltelecom purple (#663479) for the header and tabs, with the cyan accent (#33CEE1) for active statuses and interactive elements.
*   **Interactive Tabs**: The "Huawei xPON" tab is set as active, with clickable tabs to navigate back to "Сервисы" (DetailServices) and other sections.
*   **Prototype Navigation**: 
    *   **Назад (Back)** and the **Inbox** island link lead back to your interactive Inbox.
    *   The **Closed** island link takes you to the Closed Tasks view.

The screen uses the Manrope font and light theme as specified, maintaining a clean, professional look for field use.
